title: Exchange: custom retention periods for message trace data
summary: Hold: the briefing presents a ten-day query limit as applying to message trace generally, although the Exchange admin center supports longer ranges through downloadable reports. The roadmap facts and the absence of a documented custom-retention setting are supported; the licensing model and abbreviated search path need minor corrections.

claims.claim: The current message trace search window extends back 90 days.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity, first bullet
claims.claim: Today's message trace search window is queried only 10 days at a time.
claims.quote: If you specify a date/time range that's even slightly greater than 10 days: The results are available only as a downloadable CSV file (an Enhanced summary report or an Extended report).
claims.fix: Replace 'Today's documented search window is the last 90 days, queried 10 days at a time' with 'Today's documented search window is the last 90 days; Get-MessageTraceV2 returns at most 10 days of data per query'. The ten-day limit is specific to that cmdlet and near-real-time summary queries, not downloadable reports. The existing cited FAQ documents the cmdlet limit.
